structured_data.objective: Using validation-only evidence, produce bounded research and risk directives for the frozen Phase 12 protocol. Never access test metrics.
structured_data.rationale: The formal_v3 dataset (sha256: 0ed9091f1ab96d24ef5fbd41d0d080668623e954e4f15e4a277f1c217e825eb9) passed quality validation with 73,193 rows across 80 symbols in CN,HK,JP,US markets. The frozen Phase 12 protocol mandates validation-only analysis; all test metrics are strictly off-limits. This dry-run directive confines risk assessment to validation splits, sanity checks, and budget estimation, avoiding any training or evaluation that could leak test information.
